title: Food groups and a balanced plate
examples: What food group should I eat more of?
Can you show me what a balanced plate looks like?

explain.say: Today we are learning about food groups.

draw.text: Food groups and a balanced plate
Food Groups: Carbs, Protein, Fats, Fruits, Veg

explain.say: Now let me show you the real thing in 3D: a healthy plate. Look at the vegetables, the fruit and the grains. Tap any part, and I will tell you what it does.

draw.text: Food groups and a balanced plate

explain.say: Carbohydrates give your body lots of energy to play.
Protein helps your body to grow strong and repair itself.
Fats give you energy and keep your body warm.
Fruits and vegetables give us important vitamins and minerals.
A balanced plate has a little bit of everything for good health.

items: Step 3: Top with fruits and veg

draw.text: Eat a mix of all food groups

faq.q: What is the difference between carbs and fats?
faq.a: Carbohydrates are mainly for quick energy, like fuel for a car. Fats are also energy, but they are stored energy that keeps you warm.
asks: Are carbs and fats both energy sources?
What is the difference between energy from carbs and fats?

faq.q: Do I need to eat all the food groups every day?
faq.a: It is best to eat a variety of foods from all the groups every day. This makes sure you get all the vitamins your body needs.
asks: Should I eat different foods every day?
Is it okay to skip a food group sometimes?

faq.q: Are fried foods bad for me?
faq.a: Fried foods often have too much fat, which is not good for you every day. It is better to choose baked or steamed foods.
asks: What is the best way to cook food?

faq.q: Which food group gives me the most energy?
faq.a: Carbohydrates are the main source of quick energy you need for playing and learning. However, fats also store energy for later use.
asks: What gives me the most power?
Where does my body get its quick energy?

faq.q: Can I get enough nutrients from just one food group?
faq.a: No, you cannot get all the necessary nutrients from just one food group. You need a mix to keep your body working well.
asks: Is one food group enough for me?
Do I need many different foods?

facts: Carbohydrates are found in foods like bread and pasta.
Protein is important for building and repairing muscles.
Fruits and vegetables provide essential vitamins and minerals.
A balanced plate includes foods from all major groups.

quiz.say: Rice belongs to which food group?
quiz.why: Rice is a grain, and grains are a main source of carbohydrates which give energy.

wrong.1: Protein is usually found in things like beans or meat, not rice.
wrong.2: Fats are usually found in oils or nuts, not in plain cooked rice.
wrong.3: Vegetables are plants like carrots, not grains like rice.

quiz.say: If you want to build strong muscles, which food group do you need?
quiz.why: Protein contains amino acids, which are the building blocks your body uses to build muscle tissue.

wrong.1: Carbohydrates give energy, but protein is what actually builds the muscle.
wrong.2: Fats are good for warmth and energy storage, not primary muscle building.
wrong.3: Fruits give vitamins, but protein is the specific nutrient for muscle growth.

quiz.say: Which food group should make up the largest part of your plate?
quiz.show: Veggies and Fruits should be large
quiz.why: Experts recommend filling a large portion of your plate with fruits and vegetables for vitamins.

wrong.0: Protein is necessary, but it should not dominate the plate to the exclusion of vitamins.
wrong.1: Fats are useful, but they should be limited and balanced with other groups.
wrong.3: While important, too many carbs without other groups can lead to energy crashes.
